Subject: Re: Intro / Redwood demo request

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the intro, and sorry for the late note. We're interested in seeing Redwood's inference platform for a regional pilot (Tokyo + SG + SYD). A couple of us are in different offices, so apologies if this gets messy.

I can do next week on Tue/Wed morning JST (9–11am), but Aaron in Singapore mentioned afternoons SGT may work better for him. Also Duncan in Sydney prefers after 11am his time. Could you propose a few overlapping windows? If you send a calendar invite, please indicate local times for each participant — I keep getting "next day" labels when invites come from US calendars.

Best,
Mayumi Sato
Head of Digital Channels
Kokoro Retail

Date: 2027-06-28T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro / Redwood demo request

Hi Mayumi — thanks for the context and for looping in Aaron and Duncan.

Quick note up front: we see that cross‑timezone invites sometimes show up as "next day" for US schedulers; we'll spell out the local times in the invite so everyone sees their local label.

Proposed overlapping windows (local times shown):
- Option A: 10:00 SGT / 11:00 JST / 12:00 AEST — 40 minutes (walkthrough + Q&A)
- Option B: 15:00 SGT / 16:00 JST / 17:00 AEST — 40 minutes
- Option C: 08:30 SGT / 09:30 JST / 10:30 AEST — 30 minutes (short demo)

Notes: in late June, time offsets are SGT UTC+8, JST UTC+9, AEST (Sydney) UTC+10 — Australia is not on DST in June. Let me know which option works and which participants want the full walkthrough vs short session.

I will draft an invite with explicit local labels once you confirm.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks for confirming. I've created the calendar invite for Option A: 10:00 SGT / 11:00 JST / 12:00 AEST on 2027-07-06.

Invite details (pulled into body to avoid timezone UI confusion):
- 2027-07-06 10:00–10:40 SGT (UTC+8) — Singapore local time
- 2027-07-06 11:00–11:40 JST (UTC+9) — Tokyo local time
